GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider reported that she intended leading the event, however, mount failed to display sufficient early speed to do so. She stated that mount travelled comfortably throughout the event in an on-pace position trailing the leader, however, the gelding failed to quicken under pressure, before weakening in the home straight. She added that, in her opinion, the gelding raced flat. Rider dropped her left rein near the 200m. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities.  Trainer advised that gelding had come to the end of its preparation and would be sent to spell.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider reported mount travelled keenly throughout early stages with another runner racing in close proximity to the outside. She said that she then pressured her mount to improve forward & cross to the rail, obtaining the lead near the 1200m, whereby it was able to settle into a rhythm throughout the middle stages. She added that, after initially quickening on straightening, mount was unable to sustain a finishing effort, with it weakening over the concluding stages. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities.
